messages:
jess: quick question — observed some clients treating 422 from /generate as retryable. we return 422 when the prompt fails validation (too long or forbidden tokens) but some infra layers are retrying and amplifying load. should we standardize on a different status or add a clear error code in the body?

omar: 422 for validation sounds right to me. retrying a validation error is nonsense. what are the exact cases producing 422 today?

jess: mostly: prompt length > model max, disallowed content token filter, and when a per-customer rate cap on prompt size is hit. occasionally a 500 shows up for out-of-memory on long prompts too which is confusing.

cheng: we should be explicit in the body with an error_type field. e.g. "\"error_type\": \"validation_length\"" vs "\"error_type\": \"transient_oom\"". clients can use that to decide retry behavior.

lia: agree. also suggest we document a rule: 4xx = client-specified problems (never retry), 429 = rate-limit (retry with backoff), 5xx = server/transient (retryable). keep streaming semantics same.

jess: +1. example payload i was thinking:```json
{ "code": "invalid_prompt_length", "message": "input tokens (4097) exceed model max (4096)", "error_type": "validation_length", "hint": "truncate or use summary endpoint" }
```

omar: looks good. for the OOM case the runtime sometimes surfaces `internal/runtime/oom` and we return 500. we should map that to `error_type: transient_oom` and include `retry_after` when we can.

cheng: small compatibility note: if we introduce `error_type`, make it additive — don't remove existing `message` or change status mappings for older clients. treat it as opt-in for smarter clients.

lia: also add guidance in the API contract: "clients MUST NOT retry on 4xx unless documented (e.g., 429). Servers MUST not flip a validation 4xx into a 5xx for behavior changes — only when the server truly cannot classify the error."

jess: runbook item: add tests so generate endpoint returns 400/422/429/500 with canonical bodies for known cases. pinging @cheng for a schema PR to the spec.

cheng: on it. i'll open a PR with sample responses + error_type enum. will include migration notes.

ci-bot: deploy check: draft spec PR created at https://github.com/redwood-inference/api-spec/pull/219 — tests pending.

omar: one more: recommend we add an idempotency token header for long-running reranks/generate calls so retries are safe for clients who mistakenly retry. but not a substitute for correct status semantics.

lia: yep, idempotency + clear error_type should cover both safety and observability. :thumbsup:

jess: perfect. thanks all — i'll follow up with a short doc blurb for SDK teams outlining exact retry rules and example code snippets.
